claims: Maintain continuous ST segment monitoring and telemetry to detect perioperative myocardial ischemia given elevated CK and CK-MB with prior cardiac risk.
Continue oxygen via nasal cannula to maintain SpO2 above 90-92%, given current PaO2 66 mmHg on supplemental oxygen.
Recheck serum magnesium and replete if still low, as magnesium is 1.5 mg/dL despite active magnesium sulfate orders.
Monitor blood glucose every 4-6 hours and treat hyperglycemia, given glucose 226 mg/dL and whole blood glucose 196-221 mg/dL.
Assess and manage pain with the existing IV PCA hydromorphone regimen, titrating to reported pain scores.
Continue incentive spirometry and cough/deep breathing exercises to prevent atelectasis and support oxygenation.
Recheck hemoglobin and hematocrit in 12-24 hours to monitor for ongoing anemia (Hgb 10.4 g/dL, Hct 29.5%).
Monitor liver enzymes (ALT 132, AST 130) with repeat testing to assess trend.
Perform fall risk precautions and maintain bed rest with assistance for mobility, given bedfast status and Braden scores indicating risk.
Continue enoxaparin 40 mg SC daily for venous thromboembolism prophylaxis.
